blockers.description: Tauri desktop app not accessible for automated testing. The proxy add/delete/update functionality requires Tauri's invoke() IPC mechanism which only works in the Tauri WebView, not in a regular browser. Testing via Chrome connecting to http://localhost:1420 (Vite dev server) does not have access to window.__TAURI__.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Tried clicking Add button - console shows 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading transformCallback)' errors. Verified Tauri app process is running (PID 67733) but it was not launched with --remote-debugging-port flag for CDP connection.
blockers.resolution: To test these assertions, the Tauri desktop app must be launched with remote debugging enabled (e.g., on macOS: open -a 'tauri-app' --args --remote-debugging-port=9222). Then agent-browser can connect via CDP and test the full Tauri functionality.

summary: Tested 5 assertions: 0 passed, 0 failed, 5 blocked. All proxy add operations require Tauri runtime which is not available when testing via browser connecting to Vite dev server. The Tauri desktop app is running but was not launched with remote debugging enabled for CDP connection.
